newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0800 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Fed cattle and boxed beef prices lower, Cattle-on-Feed Friday.
FEEDER CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Higher index and lower corn supportive to May but deferreds seen lower.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Packers cutting back on kills but narrowing of index and futures supportive.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Lower kills may offset weak undertone to cash.
